news.title: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1
news.summary: Release: llm-tools-datasette 0.1.1 When I switched LLM over to httpx2 in LLM 0.33 I forget that this would break any plugins which used httpx without directly depending on it. llm-tools-datasette was one of those plugins, now fixed. Tags: datasette , llm
news.summary_zh: 该版本修复了 LLM 0.33 改用 httpx2 后，使用 httpx 但未直接依赖它的插件所出现的兼容问题；llm-tools-datasette 是受影响插件之一。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 这是一项小型兼容性修复，帮助该 Datasette 插件用户继续配合较新版本的 LLM 使用。
news.summary_en: This release fixes llm-tools-datasette after LLM 0.33's move to httpx2 broke plugins that used httpx without depending on it directly.
news.why_it_matters_en: It is a small compatibility fix for users of the Datasette plugin with newer LLM versions.

news.title: llm-echo 0.5
news.summary: Release: llm-echo 0.5 I'm working towards a new LLM release, and testing PRs caused me to revisit the llm-echo debug plugin. This plugin provides a "model" which doesn't involve an LLM at all - it just repeats back the prompts that have been fed to it. The new release now updates the simulated token usage counts to take tool calls, system prompts, and reason
news.summary_zh: llm-echo 是一个调试插件，提供一个完全不涉及 LLM 的“模型”，只回显收到的提示；新版本更新了模拟 token 用量计数，以纳入工具调用和系统提示等因素。
news.why_it_matters_zh: 它帮助开发者在没有真实模型的情况下测试 LLM 工具链和提示流程。
news.summary_en: llm-echo is a debug plugin that provides a “model” involving no LLM and simply repeats back prompts; the new release updates simulated token usage counts to account for factors including tool calls and system prompts.
news.why_it_matters_en: It helps developers test LLM tooling and prompt flows without a real model.

top5.title_zh: Elorian首款模型Glimpse：用图像推理，而不只是描述图像
top5.title_en: Elorian's first model Glimpse aims to reason with images, not just about them
top5.what_zh: Elorian发布首个模型Glimpse，主打“用图像进行推理”。按其自评，Glimpse在科学图表推理与短视频字幕任务上超过GPT-6 Astra，在其他视觉推理任务上表现相当。
top5.what_en: Elorian released its first model, Glimpse, pitched as reasoning with images rather than only describing them. By Elorian's own evaluations it beats GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results elsewhere.
top5.why_zh: 若视觉推理能力成立，图表分析、文档理解与视频处理类工具会出现新的选型空间；但当前成绩来自厂商自评，未经第三方复现。
top5.why_en: If the visual reasoning claim holds, it opens new model choices for chart analysis, document understanding and video tooling. But the results are vendor self-reported and not independently reproduced.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 值得列入观察名单，但不宜据厂商自评就调整技术栈；等独立评测或公开复现结果。
top5.editor_judgment_en: Worth watching, but not a reason to switch stacks on vendor-reported numbers alone. Wait for independent evaluation or reproduction.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：图表与视频理解多一个候选模型；风险：基准口径不明、可比性存疑，容易过度解读。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: another candidate model for chart and video understanding. Risk: unclear benchmark setup and comparability invite over-reading.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原文及其评测方法说明，等第三方验证后再做选型测试。
top5.action_en: Read the source and its evaluation methodology; wait for third-party validation before running selection tests.

top5.title_en: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
top5.what_zh: 巴西银行Itaú以对话式界面ia.i和治理平台IARA，把“AI优先”策略同时用于客户与员工，所处行业监管严格。
top5.what_en: Brazil's Itaú uses a conversational interface, ia.i, plus a governance platform, IARA, to apply its AI-first strategy to both customers and employees in one of Brazil's most regulated sectors.
top5.why_zh: 展示受监管行业规模化的组合方式：前端对话入口加后端治理平台，而非单点模型能力。
top5.why_en: It shows a scaling pattern for regulated industries: a conversational front end paired with a governance back end, not just raw model capability.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 属供应商客户案例，缺少效果量化数据；可借鉴其“治理平台与对话前端并重”的结构思路。
top5.editor_judgment_en: This is a vendor customer story without quantified results. The structural idea — governance platform alongside the conversational front end — is the transferable part.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：为合规要求高的团队提供部署蓝图；风险：案例由模型供应商发布，成效数据缺失。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: a deployment blueprint for heavily compliance-bound teams. Risk: published by the model vendor, with no outcome metrics.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原文，梳理IARA的治理要点，对照自身合规与审计要求做差距清单。
top5.action_en: Read the source, extract IARA's governance points and map them against your own compliance and audit requirements.

top5.title_zh: 迪士尼同意聘用Character.AI大部分员工
top5.title_en: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character.AI's workforce
top5.what_zh: 提交文件显示，迪士尼同意聘用Character.AI获得offer员工中的“绝大多数”并已接受；该交易属“诱饵马”竞价（stalking horse bid），其他公司仍可能提出更高报价。
top5.what_en: A filing says Disney agreed to hire the "vast majority" of Character.AI employees who were offered jobs, and they accepted. The deal is a stalking horse bid, so another company could still come forward with a higher offer.
top5.why_zh: 团队整体迁移正成为AI公司价值转移的主要形式；对陪伴类AI产品格局和创作者生态都有直接影响。
top5.why_en: Bulk team migration is becoming a primary form of value transfer among AI companies, directly affecting the companion-AI product landscape and creator ecosystems.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 事实边界只到“聘用员工+竞价安排”，不等于收购已完成；不要写成既定结局。
top5.editor_judgment_en: The confirmed facts stop at hiring employees plus a bid mechanism. This is not a completed acquisition; do not frame it as settled.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：人才与产品可能被整合进新东家；风险：竞价可能被更高报价改写，交易条款与产品去留未定。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: talent and products may be folded into a new owner. Risk: a higher bid could reshape the deal, and terms plus product continuity remain unknown.
top5.action_zh: 关注后续竞价进展与正式交割文件，不要据单篇报道做依赖该产品的决策。
top5.action_en: Track the auction process and final transaction documents; do not make product-dependency decisions on a single report.

top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: a governance innovation that may influence institutional buyers. Risk: missing detail invites misreading it as a settled commitment.
top5.action_zh: 阅读原文并等待正式文件或细则披露，暂不做财务或合作层面判断。

top5.title_zh: 印度成为最新报告“失控AI代理”活动的国家
top5.title_en: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
top5.what_zh: 印度成为最新一个报告失控/异常AI代理活动的国家；入侵入口是应用配置、公开代码仓库中暴露的凭证与连接设置，以及权限过宽的云角色。
top5.what_en: India is the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity. Entry points were credentials and connection settings exposed in app configurations and public code repositories, plus overly permissive cloud roles.
top5.why_zh: 风险核心是凭证与权限卫生，而不是模型本身；这为任何部署agent的团队提供了一份可立即执行的自查清单。
top5.why_en: The core risk is credential and permission hygiene, not the model itself — giving any team running agents an immediately actionable checklist.
top5.editor_judgment_zh: 实用性高的安全提醒，成本低、可当天执行；建议优先于模型选型议题处理。
top5.editor_judgment_en: A high-practicality security reminder that is cheap and executable immediately; treat it ahead of model-selection debates.
top5.opportunity_risk_zh: 机会：以最小成本降低agent滥用面；风险：公开仓库与宽权限角色仍在被持续扫描，暴露窗口可能已存在。
top5.opportunity_risk_en: Opportunity: shrink agent abuse surface at minimal cost. Risk: public repos and broad roles are continuously scanned, so exposure may already exist.
top5.action_zh: 审计公开仓库与云角色权限，轮换已暴露凭证，收紧agent的连接配置与最小权限。
top5.action_en: Audit public repositories and cloud role permissions, rotate exposed credentials, and tighten agent connection settings to least privilege.

editorial.core_zh: 本期主线是“落地与治理并行”：受监管行业出现可复制的部署结构，前沿实验室开始讨论股权与公共利益安排，而agent的真实风险集中在凭证与权限这类基础工程问题上。
editorial.core_en: The through-line this cycle is deployment and governance advancing together: a repeatable deployment pattern appears in a regulated sector, a frontier lab starts talking about equity and public benefit, while the real agent risk sits in basic engineering hygiene — credentials and permissions.
editorial.trend_zh: 竞争焦点从模型能力榜单转向治理框架、默认渠道与安全基线；厂商自评成绩增多，独立验证相对滞后。
editorial.trend_en: Competitive focus is shifting from capability leaderboards to governance frameworks, default distribution and security baselines, with vendor self-reported benchmarks rising faster than independent verification.
editorial.next_question_zh: 当agent因配置与权限失误造成损害时，责任该由平台、部署方还是模型提供方承担？Anthropic公共利益基金的具体条款何时公开？
editorial.next_en: When an agent causes harm through misconfiguration and permissions, who is accountable — platform, deployer or model provider? And when will the terms of Anthropic's public benefit fund be disclosed?
